facts.fact: Xalam Analytics estimates about five live commercial data centre facilities in Uganda in 2024, leasing colocation space to third parties, with Raxio the largest and only carrier-neutral one.

facts.fact: Xalam Analytics states the Uganda Data Protection and Privacy Act of 2019 provides the core framework for data protection in Uganda.
Xalam Analytics states the government passed the Data Protection and Privacy Regulations in 2021, setting rules on collecting, processing and storing personal data.
Xalam Analytics cites a Digital Government Strategy to transform Uganda into a digitally empowered society by 2027.
